implementation.summary: compile_relation_blocks now indexes only included verified Fourfold bindings as admissible cross-plane authority before scanning Forest edges. A selected or discover-all directed cross-plane ForestEdge must match an exact included verified binding or compilation fails closed before Forest evidence/fact materialization. When the exact binding exists, the raw Forest edge is an admission check only and is not added to edge_records or facts; the verified CrossPlaneBinding is the sole cross-plane row and provenance source. With include_verified_bindings=false, an observed selected/discover-all cross-plane relation therefore fails closed rather than becoming an authoritative raw-Forest row. Explicitly unrelated selections still prune the raw cross-plane edge and can compile independent same-plane relations.
implementation.gardener_note: The repair stays inside the existing compiler owner and removes the previous dual raw-Forest/binding materialization path for cross-plane rows. No second compiler, verifier, graph schema, relation authority, fact store, cache, backend, registry or public API was introduced.
implementation.semantic_boundary: CrossPlaneBinding remains the verified semantic relation authority between distinct Fourfold planes. ForestEdge can signal an observed cross-plane relation but cannot independently mint a sparse authoritative Tensor coordinate.
implementation.same_plane_scope: unchanged; same-plane Forest relations remain governed by retained relation digests and the existing directed/undirected projection rules.
